Scoring

How points work

The most popular answer scores 25. Points rise down the top ten, to between 40 and 60 for 10th place: higher when there are only a few possible answers, lower when there are hundreds. Any other right answer scores 60 to 80, more the less common it is. A Gem, a rare right answer, scores 100. Five prompts, so a perfect game is 500.

Small spelling slips are forgiven. Not on our list? Played in a chatbot such as Claude, press Check again and the AI checks it, up to twice. Popularity is the AI's estimate, not a survey.
